reviews.text: Zach did a great job servicing our office’s HVAC system! He was thorough and took the time to clearly explain what he found and how he fixed the issues. We really appreciated his attention to detail and friendly, helpful service. Thank you, Zach!

reviews.text: I contacted Thermotech to fix a repair in my duct work in the attic. Joe the technician was very timely, knowledgeable and professional and did an excellent job correcting it. I highly recommend him and this company as I have used their services many times.
